title: RNA Modification Coverage Benchmarking Pipeline - Input Samplesheet Schema
description: Schema for the input samplesheet used by the RNA modification coverage benchmarking pipeline

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq.errorMessage: FASTQ file path must be provided and must have extension .fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz, or .fq.gz

genome_size.errorMessage: Genome size must be a number optionally followed by k/K, m/M, or g/G (with optional bp/b suffix). Examples: 4500000, 4.5m, 4.5Mbp

min_length.errorMessage: Minimum read length must be a positive integer

length_weight.errorMessage: Length weight must be a non-negative number

mean_q_weight.errorMessage: Mean quality weight must be a non-negative number

window_q_weight.errorMessage: Window quality weight must be a non-negative number

keep_percent.errorMessage: Keep percent must be between 0 and 100

min_mean_q.errorMessage: Minimum mean quality must be a non-negative number

min_window_q.errorMessage: Minimum window quality must be a non-negative number

window_size.errorMessage: Window size must be a positive integer

trim.errorMessage: Trim must be one of: true, false, yes, no, 1, or 0

split.errorMessage: Split must be a positive integer

assembly.errorMessage: Assembly file must have extension .fasta, .fa, .fna, or gzipped versions

illumina_1.errorMessage: Illumina R1 file must have extension .fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz, or .fq.gz

illumina_2.errorMessage: Illumina R2 file must have extension .fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz, or .fq.gz
